sloka: एवमुक्तास्तु रामेण वानरास्ते महाबलाः ।ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो रामं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः ।। ६.१२५.२० ।।
transliteration: evamuktāstu rāmeṇa vānarāste mahābalāḥ ।ūcuḥ prāñjalayo rāmaṁ rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.125.20 ।।

translations.english: "O Jewel among kings! We will see you being consecrated and see Kausalya, greet her and return back to our own house."
